notes.title: 0.45.6 - Hotfix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed login issues on Asian Windows systems.
[*] Chat bug fixed: the last message no longer gets hidden in long chats.
[*] Player names in chat now appear in blue for better readability.
[/list]

Fixed bugs : 
- User can loggin even if the account is already logged in
- Current map name displaying above the minimap
- Newly created accounts can't login when they launch the game for the first time
- Lava crystal wing image now correctly display on the welcome window
- Minimap buttons zoom & dezoom
- Fixed some particle system that were not displaying correctly

Game improvements :
- You can now hide/display the craft panel in the inventory window
- Improved player movements & animations

[b]Shortcut icons rework
Loader added in HomeScreen
New admin commands[/b]
[list]
[*] Teleport player
[*] Teleport to player
[/list]

[b]Role system[/b]
[list]
[*]Admin : pink colored name
[*]Contributor : yellow colored name
[*]Player : black colored name
[/list]

[b]Tooltip rework[/b]
[list]
[*]Better looking tooltips
[*]Wings experience displayed as a progress bar
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Monster animation not playing until the end
[*]Some monster models were not destroying when behing inactive
[/list]

[b]New Wings added[/b]
[list]
[*] Superior Desert Crystal Wings (crafted with Desert Crystal Wings x10)
[*] Superior Ice Crystal Wings (crafted with Ice Crystal Wings x10)
[*] Superior Jungle Crystal Wings (crafted with Jungle Crystal Wings x10)
[*] Superior Lava Crystal Wings (crafted with Laval Crystal Wings x10)
[/list]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44905585/526ccdd529e78c9a220e6b84daaa11ca0cfbe0d3.png[/img]

[b]New craft added[/b]
[list]
[*] Desert Crystal Wings (120) : Desert crystal x500 (32)
[*] Ice Crystal Wings (121) : Ice crystal x500 (94)
[*] Jungle Crystal Wings (123) : Jungle crystal x500 (100)
[*] Lava Crystal Wings (122) : Lava crystal x500 (97)
[/list]

[b]Added Tooltip over crafting recipes[/b]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44905585/1d41f53555e509a60d4b068ee307d403a0fce2ef.png[/img]

[b]Dungeon Balancing[/b]
The Ice Cavern : Monster kill required insice instance increased to 38 to spawn the dungeon’s boss
Madam Claud’s Lair (MCL) : Monster kill required inside instance increased to 40 to spawn the dungeon’s boss

[b]Job icons rework[/b]
[b]Character selection rework[/b]

 [img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44905585/f63aefee1377f6644b97c0250e019735bcba97dc.png[/img]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed crash while crafting wings
[*] Fixed broken shortcuts
[*] Fixed client side damage showing negative values when damage reduction is over 100%
[/list]

[b]Wing system revamp[/b]
New wing system is out !

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Fox banking item makes all inventory disabled
Fix dungeon entrance error
Fix banked item not appearing
Disabled resolution option
Fix character is not saved when disconnecting from exit menu
Fix first item on server not appearing (getNewPlayerItemID starts at 1)
Fix no more wing experience if the character is level max
Fix first login bug after account creation
Fix account creation
